commentary: With the Nifty breaching critical support and market breadth deteriorating to a frail 28%, William O'Neil's market-direction principle is paramount: three out of four equities inevitably succumb to general market distribution. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline warns that even constructive Stage 2 breakouts face elevated failure rates when institutional liquidity contracts amid macroeconomic headwinds. In a weak tape, capital preservation takes precedence over aggressive deployment. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate maintaining predominantly cash positions, restricting watchlists strictly to resilient leaders demonstrating powerful relative strength divergence, and honoring stops without hesitation. Cash remains an active, defensive tactical allocation.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: SEPA (Minervini) | CANSLIM (O'Neil) | Stage Analysis (Weinstein) | Darvas Box & Livermore Discipline

ACE.technical: Consolidating in a clean 12.8% cup with a shallow 5.6% upper-half handle. Price commands the rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with positive MACD momentum. Relative strength is robust against a collapsing benchmark, positioning near its 1269.27 neckline pivot.
ACE.fundamental: Domestic crane leader with over 60% market share. Generates 32% ROCE, expanding 20.5% EBITDA margins, and zero net debt. KATO Works JV expands high-tonnage exports, though latest EPS growth (+22.3%) lands slightly under the strict 25% threshold.
ACE.risk: A breakdown below 1188.57 or failure to absorb selling at the 1269 pivot invalidates the setup; strict stop discipline applies.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: Base structure remains incomplete above long-term averages. The brief poke above the 321.27 pivot followed by a lower close triggers Jesse Livermore's danger signal, indicating supply overhead and an absence of institutional breakout accumulation.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Operates valuable liquid and gas logistics infrastructure, but high valuation (P/E >100x), modest ROCE (~7.6%), and recent net profit contraction (-7% YoY) fail core CANSLIM criteria.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Violation of the 290.68 stop confirms pattern failure; failed pivot clearance requires standing aside immediately.

AETHER.technical: Constructing a constructive double-bottom pattern testing overhead neckline resistance at 1799.80. Trades firmly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with MACD above zero. Relative strength line is hitting new highs ahead of price, signaling institutional accumulation.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemicals producer benefiting from 10-year exclusive supply contracts. Demonstrates healthy 31% operating margins and low debt, though working capital remains extended (179 days) and multi-quarter earnings consistency is developing.
AETHER.risk: A close below the 1670.91 stop level terminates the setup; general market weakness could induce sharp pivot failure.

AHCL.technical: Breaking out to fresh 52-week highs on a 20-day high clearance at 34.69. Moving averages are in bullish Stage 2 alignment (EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200), though volume conviction requires close monitoring given small-cap liquidity.
AHCL.fundamental: API and intermediate manufacturer scaling via the Remember India Healthlinks acquisition. Delivers strong 20.8% ROCE and modest 0.35 D/E, but faces gross margin compression from raw material inflation and high debtor days (220 days).
AHCL.risk: A breach of the 29.38 stop terminates the breakout; high volatility demands strict risk limits.

AONELIQUID.technical: Shows an artificial flat-line 20-day high breakout driven entirely by accrued interest in an overnight cash fund. Moving average alignment reflects pure cash-equivalent mathematics rather than institutional Stage 2 accumulation.
AONELIQUID.fundamental: Angel One Nifty 1D Rate Liquid ETF is an open-ended debt exchange-traded fund tracking overnight money-market repo rates. CANSLIM earnings metrics, OPM, ROCE, and balance sheet operating dynamics are entirely inapplicable.
AONELIQUID.risk: Opportunity cost and cash drag; equity trend frameworks do not apply to money-market cash instruments.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Exceptional technical setup in a Stage 2 advance. Forming a tight double bottom beneath 953.70 with clean moving-average alignment (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200). Demonstrating standout relative strength divergence by pressing 52-week highs during a severe general market selloff.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: High-margin High-Tech Products segment drove an explosive +151% EPS and +111% revenue leap in Q1 FY27. Operating margin widened to 40.9%, ROCE reaches 29.6%, and the company is essentially debt-free with D/E of 0.01.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Failure to hold the 856.75 structural swing stop invalidates the pivot; severe market headwinds require defensive position sizing.
